verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is itself a documented public API. It has a quickstart, per-endpoint API reference pages (web, news, local POIs, rich search, answers, suggestions, spell check), a browser playground, curl examples, an OpenAI-compatible answers endpoint and an llms.txt index. A community commenter also reports it 'works great with OpenClaw' on the AI plan. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a brief community mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
